reuse.why: Puts every new rule (saved templates, #fixed groups, the hidden opt-in) into the tree's single shouldFillCategory/HiddenPolicy definition, and the new last-month action reuses getAverageCategories and averageToBudgetAmount.

duplication.why: Rules are not duplicated, but setZero now carries a verbatim copy of getAverageCategories' categories/groups/notes query, and the 'includeHiddenCategories ? include : default' mapping is repeated per action.

placement.why: Category-selection rules live in fill-categories.ts, which the tree documents as their single definition; actions only fetch data and pass their policy.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (templates/hidden, last-month action, #fixed groups, hidden opt-in) plus tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: A maintainer changes the skip rules in one function; the only friction is the two copies of the candidate query, which must stay in sync with FillCandidate's fields.

disguised_duplication.where: setZero's query is a plain copy of getAverageCategories' query, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory keeps its option shape (new rules apply to every action via FillCandidate data fields); getAverageCategories gains an includeHiddenCategories parameter; copyPreviousMonth, setZero, the N-month averages and setLastMonthSpending all decide through shouldFillCategory.
